integrity: Induction from an exhaustive 128-word base and algebraic equality-edge suffix analysis; independent direct and edge-based finite computations in verify.py.
scientific_limitations: Finite theorem covers all binary words of length at least seven with antipalindromic shortfall at most one. No higher-defect classification, no assertion of independence of review, no historical priority proof. Infinite corollary uses prefix shortfall, not all-factor defect.
title: Rigidity of binary words missing exactly one antipalindromic factor
